rationale: All three lenses completed. All 10 acceptance criteria pass. Core fix (client_type-only check, case-insensitive, both spellings) is correct and symmetric across proxy_router and LLMProxyMonitoringService. No blocking findings. Deferred items are maintenance concerns (defensive str() cast for non-string client_type values, stale docstring in track_usage, test name misleading after behavioural change) — not correctness defects. Removal of CODEMIE_CLI as a classification signal is required per AC-2 and is not a regression. _check_cli_version version-gate decoupling is pre-existing, not introduced by this change.

business_review.text: _is_cli_request returns False when client_type is codemie-chrome-extension.
business_review.notes: Both implementations return False for codemie-chrome-extension. Test test_chrome_extension_client_type_returns_false confirms.

business_review.text: A non-empty X-CodeMie-CLI header alone does not classify a request as CLI when its client_type is not codemie-cli or codemie_cli.
business_review.notes: CODEMIE_CLI header path removed from both _is_cli_request implementations. Tests test_non_empty_cli_header_alone_does_not_classify_as_cli and test_unrecognized_client_type_with_nonempty_cli_header_returns_false confirm.

business_review.text: Chrome extension spend through /v1/chat/completions is assigned to BudgetCategory.PLATFORM.
business_review.notes: test_chrome_extension_client_type_uses_platform_budget in proxy_router tests confirms PLATFORM routing.

business_review.text: Chrome extension codemie_litellm_proxy_usage documents do not carry cli_request: true.
business_review.notes: LLMProxyMonitoringService._is_cli_request updated identically; monitoring service tests confirm.
codemie-cli in membership set. test_codemie_cli_client_type_returns_true in both test files.
codemie_cli in membership set. test_codemie_cli_underscore_client_type_returns_true in both test files.
.lower() applied before membership test. test_cli_client_type_case_insensitive_upper (CODEMIE-CLI) and test_cli_client_type_case_insensitive_mixed (Codemie-Cli) confirm.

business_review.text: Genuine CodeMie CLI spend continues to be assigned to BudgetCategory.CLI.
business_review.notes: client_type=codemie-cli still returns True; CLI budget path unchanged.

business_review.text: Existing billing and analytics queries using attributes.cli_request == True continue to include genuine CLI traffic but exclude Chrome extension traffic.
business_review.notes: Only codemie-cli/codemie_cli produce cli_request=true in both proxy_router and monitoring service. No query-level changes needed.

business_review.text: Automated tests cover all required cases.
business_review.notes: Full coverage: codemie-chrome-extension, codemie-cli, codemie_cli, casing variants (CODEMIE-CLI, Codemie-Cli), unrecognized client type with non-empty header, missing/null/empty client_type. Both test files updated.

standards_review.notes: Both commits use EPMCDME-14260: prefix per git-workflow guide. d06eaddbe: 'Fix _is_cli_request in proxy_router to key on client_type'. 1202c2d13: 'Fix LLMProxyMonitoringService._is_cli_request to key on client_type'.
2-line implementation in each location. Logic symmetric across both functions. No ruff violations introduced. Consistent style with surrounding code.
No auth bypass, no secret exposure, no injection vectors. Header-to-classification logic tightened (removal of header-presence path reduces attack surface).

deferred.note: Defensive str() cast: (request_info.get(CLIENT_TYPE) or '') could AttributeError on non-string truthy value. Low real-world risk (HTTP header path always produces str), but defensive cast str(... or '') would harden it.
Docstring still says 'cli_request attribute derived from the X-CodeMie-CLI header'. Should say 'derived from X-CodeMie-Client (client_type)'.
test_missing_codemie_cli_key_sets_cli_flag_false — name misleading after change; test verifies 'web' client_type produces cli_flag=false, not absence of header.
Two byte-for-byte identical implementations in separate modules. Consider extracting shared helper to prevent future divergence.
